hooks.command: mkdir -p .claude/tool-inputs && input=$(cat) && name=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.tool_name // "unknown"') && printf '%s' "$input" | jq '.tool_input' > ".claude/tool-inputs/${name}.json" || true

input=$(cat); if printf '%s' "$input" | grep -qE 'github-token'; then ts=$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ") && mkdir -p .claude/audit && printf '%s\t%s\n' "$ts" "$input" >> .claude/audit/blocked-calls.log; printf 'Blocked by token-block hook: tool input references a protected credential filename. Refusing to read, write, or otherwise expose secrets. If you need a token, use an env var or secret manager — never inline the literal filename in a tool call.\n' >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0

mkdir -p .claude/tool-outputs && input=$(cat) && name=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.tool_name // "unknown"') && printf '%s' "$input" | jq '.tool_response // .tool_output // .' > ".claude/tool-outputs/${name}.json" || true
